turns.question: What was the average number of customer service calls per day in September 2026, counting days with no calls as zero?
turns.answer: September 2026 had 32 calls labelled (a model-derived count over 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30); the semantic layer has no per-day average, so I can't state one. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
